notes: The supplied referential subject *he* of `וְאֵין שֵׁנִי` → *and he hath not a second* was folded into the `אַיִן` unit, but no morpheme licenses it: rule 50 admits only a supplied dummy into the existential unit, and no suffix stands in this clause for a referential pronoun to realize. The same chapter marks such a word `added` at ECC.4.12 (*a man*) and ECC.4.15 (*they*), so this was one construction analysed two ways with nothing in the source to license the difference. `אַיִן` keeps the recast *hath not*, headed on the negation, as it does in the parallel clause at ECC.4.10.
